name: panorama-water-tank-nested
description: Defensive workspace alias resolving cd apps/mobile invocations inside apps/mobile

scripts.preinstall: node -e "console.log('[NESTED ALIAS] Installing parent dependencies...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm install', { cwd: require('path').resolve(__dirname, '../..'), stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('[NESTED ALIAS] Building parent project...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', { cwd: require('path').resolve(__dirname, '../..'), stdio: 'inherit' });"
